current_repo_note: Google's May 2026 transition post says it is unifying its efforts into Antigravity and that Gemini CLI stopped serving free and Google AI Pro or Ultra requests on 2026-06-18, while committing to continue supporting the tool for Code Assist Standard and Enterprise licensees. The repository is not archived and shipped code during this review, and Google designated no successor record, so the status stays active and no supersession is recorded.
weaknesses: Recovery and trace ergonomics are still evolving

Google stopped serving free and consumer-subscription requests on 2026-06-18 while directing those users to Antigravity, so the open repository remains active but its no-cost path now requires a paid Code Assist license
why_it_matters: Shows how a provider-backed terminal agent can remain extensible and open source.
